QuestInfo.name: The Third Trade
QuestInfo.0: It's time for the final trade with Agent M. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the Skeleton Commanders who have taken over the Prohibited Area and collect #b50 Horse Skulls#k.
QuestInfo.2: You completed the final trade with Agent M.

0.0: This will be your greatest challenge. Go to the very end of the Excavation Site and annihilate the Skeleton Commanders. With them gone, the others will surely scatter.

yes.0: This is it. Bring me #b50 Horse Skulls#k, and you'll have your alliance.

no.0: Oh, you don't care about the planet? You aren't one of THEM, are you?

1.0: All right. You held up your end of the bargain. Just let me contact my superiors...

item.0: I need 50 of those Horse Skulls. They make charming, rustic decorations.
